hyps.why: Two 3x3 convs into the output node are redundant, so the second adds little.
A skip shortcut to the output lets the network bypass conv capacity, so extra conv on edge 5 is wasted.
A 3x3 upstream already supplies the receptive field, so another 3x3 on edge 2 gains less.
Replacing none adds a brand-new path, whereas replacing skip_connect removes a useful identity path.
A conv paired with a pooling branch gives complementary features at the output node.
Mixed kernel sizes on parallel inputs to node 3 are more diverse than matched ones.
Downstream convs on the chain only have features worth refining if edge 0 already extracts them.
With no shortcut, all signal must flow through the convs, so improving edge 4 matters more.
After a 3x3 on edge 0, a cheap 1x1 on edge 2 suffices to mix channels, so it gains relatively more.
Replacing a skip removes an optimization-friendly identity path, offsetting the conv's gain.
